description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the returned CasterId.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

description.zh:
布局ID。
多个布局ID用英文逗号（,）隔开，不填则返回该导播台下所有布局。

如果您通过[AddStudioLayout接口](~~2848062~~)添加虚拟演播厅的布局设置，请查看AddStudioLayout接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值。
description.en:
The layout ID. To specify multiple layout IDs, separate them with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, all layouts of the production studio are returned.

If you add a layout by calling the [AddStudioLayout](~~2848062~~) operation, use the returned LayoutId.

descriptions.zh:
先通过[AddStudioLayout接口](~~2848062~~)添加虚拟演播厅的布局设置，再调用本接口获取虚拟演播厅布局设置。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为15次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You must first call the [AddStudioLayout](~~2848062~~) operation to add a layout for a virtual production studio. You can then call this operation to query the layout settings.

## QPS limits

This operation supports up to 15 queries per second (QPS) per user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
